page.overview:
Who is Luna Fluxa?

(born 9 August 2010) is a Spanish karting competitor currently part of the Mercedes Junior Team. In February 2022, at the age of 11, she joined the Mercedes Junior Team, as one the youngest driver and first female driver to join the team.
